stem: Which sentence from the story hints that the merchant plans to trick the peasant?

options.label: A
options.text: Each time the merchant came to a crossroads, he told everyone that he would give one hundred lei to anyone who found the money.

options.label: B
options.text: The merchant trusted no one, so he went aside to count the money.

options.label: C
options.text: To his surprise, all one thousand coins were still in the bag.

options.label: D
options.text: He wondered how he could get out of his promise and still appear to be fair.
